# Techrola

> Techrola is India's platform for discovering 550+ government schemes, scholarships, and welfare programs, plus AI-powered career tools (internship reports, mock interviews) and a referral earning program.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and search government schemes by state and category.
- [Career Program](/career-program): 6-step gated career growth path for promoters.
- [AI Tools](/ai-tools): AI-powered career and learning utilities.
- [AI Report Generator](/create-report): Generate internship reports as DOCX.
- [Mock Interview](/mock-interview): AI-driven interview practice across 4 paths.
- [Plans](/plans): Free vs Pro subscription tiers.
- [Subscription](/subscription): Manage Pro subscription via WhatsApp.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top earners in the referral program.
- [Install](/install): Install Techrola as a PWA on Android/iOS.
- [About Us](/about-us): Mission and what we offer.
- [Contact Us](/contact-us): Email, phone, and address.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Data handling.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms-conditions): Usage terms.
- [Refund Policy](/refund-policy): Refund rules.

## Notes

- Scheme detail pages live at /scheme/{slug}.
- All AI-generated scheme info includes a disclaimer to verify on official government sites.
